_about: Synton Fenix I emulation - topology parameters. Edit values; keys are <module>.<quantity>. conf = evidence level from the engineering brief (HIGH/MOD/LOW/UNK). Loaded at plugin start from the bundle and overridden by ~/Library/Application Support/FenixI/topology_params.json if present.

sys.rout_ohm.note: Op-amp output series resistance used by the stacked-output rule (§2)

sys.ilimit_ma.note: Per-driver output source-current limit, mA (TL07x class)

sys.isink_ratio.note: Sink-current limit as a fraction of the source limit (asymmetric output stage; makes stacked-output fights deterministic)

sys.clip_v.note: Op-amp clip level on ±15 V rails

sys.clip_knee_v.note: Soft-knee width of the op-amp clip (§5 'soft knee <= 0.5 V')

sys.noise_floor_dbfs.note: White noise added per op-amp output stage (cosmetic). <= -200 disables

sys.ctl_smooth_ms.note: Pot smoothing time constant for host-automated controls (software only)

sys.ac_hpf_hz.note: HPF for the AC-coupled paths (RM1 AC out, ESP audio)

sys.gate_hi_v.note: Gate/trigger input reads high above this (II PP thresholds)

sys.gate_lo_v.note: Gate/trigger input reads low below this (hysteresis)

vco.sine_shape_mix.note: Strength of the discrete differential-pair shaper residual (0 = ideal sine, 1 = cubic, >1 harder); sets odd-harmonic THD ~1-3%

vco.sine_asym.note: Even-harmonic asymmetry of the sine shaper (0 = symmetric; 0.008 ~ 1 % H2)

vco.tri_fold_corner.note: Rounding of the full-wave-rectifier corner that makes the triangle (0..0.2 of amplitude)

vco.reset_time_us.note: Comparator/JFET reset time; saw amplitude shrinks by f*t (100-300 ns in hardware)

vco.sync_window_curve.note: Exponent mapping the Sync level pot+CV to the soft-sync window (1 = linear)

vco.subphase_law.note: Sub-phase CV law: 0 = linear delay in CV, 1 = exponential

vco.fm_hz_per_v.note: Linear FM input scale (Hz per volt, additive current into the integrator)

vco.thru_zero_fm.note: 1 = allow through-zero linear FM; 0 = core stalls at 0 Hz (default per brief)

vco.hf_tracking_err.note: Bulk-resistance droop term r*I of the expo converter (0 = calibrated)

vco.freq_pot_octaves.note: Octaves spanned by the Frequency pot (sub-audio to above audio)

vco.freq_pot_min_hz.note: Frequency at pot fully CCW with 0 V CV

vco.pw_cv_full_v.note: PWM CV swing (±V) that sweeps the full pulse-width window at PW=12 o'clock

lfo.pot_octaves.note: Octaves spanned by LFO1/2 Freq pot ('reaches audible spectrum')

lfo3.min_hz.note: LFO3 frequency at pot CCW (manual only)

lfo3.pot_octaves.note: Octaves spanned by LFO3 Freq (log pot)

lfo.sym_min.note: Symmetry pot minimum duty (II PP documents 3..97 %)

lfo2.gate_mode.note: LFO2 Gate input: 0 = hold integrator while low (run while high), 1 = reset while low

lfo1.trig_mode.note: LFO1 Trigger: 0 = force integrator to low rail (restart), 1 = hold while high

lfo3.sine_thd.note: LFO3 diode-shaper sine blend (0 = ideal sine, 1 = heavy triangle residue)

vcf12.vt_eff_mv.note: Effective OTA tanh scale per integrator input (CA3280 + linearising diodes; 60-120 mV)

vcf12.res_overdrive.note: Resonance->damping law: res pot at max reaches (this) x self-oscillation

vcf12.osc_limit_v.note: Integrator output soft limit (OTA output swing); sets the self-oscillation amplitude, which is then flat across the sweep

vcf12.pot_octaves.note: Octaves spanned by the Frequency pot

vcf12.atten_ratio.note: Input attenuation before the OTA integrators (signal /ratio, output x ratio); sets how hard 4 Vpp drives Vt_eff

vcf3.vt_mv.note: Thermal voltage of the ladder stages (BJT; 26 mV at 300 K)

vcf3.input_scale.note: Volts-to-ladder scaling (how hard 4 Vpp drives the first stage)

vcf3.k_osc_scale.note: Multiplier on the analytic self-oscillation loop gain of the chosen feedback topology (1 = exact)

vcf3.selfosc_pot_pos.note: Resonance pot position where oscillation 'just starts' with no CV (designer: 10 o'clock)

vcf3.k_max_ratio.note: Feedback gain at Resonance pot max, as a multiple of the self-oscillation gain

vcf3.voicing.note: 0 = early (bright, raw ladder), 1 = late ('Moog-ish' retune after owner feedback)

vcf3.early_drive.note: Input drive multiplier for the early voicing

vcf3.late_drive.note: Input drive multiplier for the late voicing

vcf3.early_fb_comp.note: Early voicing: fraction of feedback taken from stage 4 instead of stage 5 (0 = pure 5-pole feedback)

vcf3.late_fb_comp.note: Late voicing: fraction of feedback taken from stage 4 (closer to a 4-pole Moog ladder)

vcf3.passband_comp.note: Resonance passband-loss compensation 0..1 (0 = classic ladder bass loss)

vcf3.pot_octaves.note: Octaves spanned by the Frequency pot

vcf3.tap12_gain.note: Output make-up gain of the '12 dB' stage-2 tap

vcf3.tap24_gain.note: Output make-up gain of the '24 dB' (5-pole) output

eg.overshoot_target.note: Attack RC charges toward (this x full-scale) so the stage ends at ~63-90% of the way

eg.time_min_ms.note: Fastest attack/decay/release time constant (ms) at pot CCW

eg.time_max_s.note: Slowest time constant (s) at pot CW (designer: '<1 ms to >50 s')

eg.cv_oct_per_v.note: Decay/Release time CV scaling: +1 V -> x2 time (II PP: 'higher CV = longer time')

eg.retrigger_from_level.note: 1 = retrigger continues from current level (no reset to zero)

eg.peak_min_ms.note: Peak-hold monostable minimum (ms) at pot CCW

eg.peak_max_s.note: Peak-hold monostable maximum (s) at pot CW

eg.level_pot_law.note: Sustain/Accent-level 10k C pots: 0 = literal reverse-log (90% at mid), 1 = wired reversed = audio taper (10% at mid)

vca.vt_eff_mv.note: OTA tanh scale on the VCA signal path (after internal attenuation)

vca.atten_ratio.note: Internal attenuation before the OTA (signal /ratio, output x ratio)

vca.cv_full_v.note: CV at which the linear VCA reaches unity gain

vca.offset_db.note: Signal leak with CV at 0 (OTA offset)

cvmix1.gain_max.note: CV Mix1 Gain pot at max (x)

port.time_min_ms.note: Portamento lag time constant at pot CCW (ms)

port.time_max_s.note: Portamento lag time constant at pot CW (s)

slew.rate_min_v_s.note: Slew limiter slowest rate (V/s) at pot CW

slew.rate_max_v_s.note: Slew limiter fastest rate (V/s) at pot CCW

slew.gain_err_pct.note: 'No defined unity gain' - small static gain error (±2 %)

sh.droop_v_per_s.note: S&H hold-cap droop ('may gradually decrease', tens of mV/s)

sh.aperture_glitch_mv.note: S&H JFET switch charge-injection step at sample (mV)

rm.scale.note: Four-quadrant multiplier scaling: out = A*B*scale (II PP: A*B/4)

rm.leak_a_db.note: Carrier A leak into the product (trimmed residual)

rm.leak_b_db.note: Carrier B leak into the product (trimmed residual)

rm.am_gain.note: RM1 'am' input: B_eff = B + am*am_gain (SOS: inputs 1+3 give the same product at lower amplitude)

noise.clock_min_hz.note: Digital noise clock VCO at Timbre pot CCW

noise.clock_max_hz.note: Digital noise clock VCO at Timbre pot CW ('>50 kHz blue noise')

noise.analog_tilt_db.note: Analog noise spectral tilt per octave (0 = white, -3 = pink)

noise.analog_amp_v.note: Analog noise RMS-ish amplitude at level max (V)

noise.vlf_hz.note: VLF random: 2-pole low-pass cutoff on the analog noise (1-3 Hz)

esp.gain_min_db.note: Audio-in Gain pot at CCW (II PP module)

esp.trig_slope_v_ms.note: Audio-in 1 Trigger fires when d(env)/dt exceeds this (V/ms)

esp.env_gain.note: Envelope follower output scale (V per V peak)

out.full_scale_v.note: Volts mapped to 0 dBFS at the host output (software scaling)

in.full_scale_v.note: Host 0 dBFS maps to this many volts at the 1/4-inch inputs

vintage.on.note: 0 = calibrated instrument (default); 1 = apply small 1 V/oct errors + HF droop

vintage.track_err_pct.note: 1 V/oct scale error per VCO when vintage is on (<= 0.3 %)

vintage.hf_droop.note: HF droop term per VCO when vintage is on
